The IRGC said it launched a heavy ballistic missile strike on Camp Titin, a U.S. Marine base near the Gulf of Aqaba in Jordan, in retaliation for a U.S. attack in Sirik, Iran, which it says killed and wounded dozens of civilians.
According to the IRGC, the strike caused significant U.S. casualties and destroyed key facilities and attack helicopters.
The IRGC said its retaliatory operations would continue.

Russia has secretly helped Iran develop supersonic cruise missile technology through a covert programme that began in 2023.
Russian missile specialists have reportedly advised Iran on ramjet propulsion, which could enable missiles to fly at several times the speed of sound and threaten US warships and other targets.
Iran has built and tested the propulsion system, though there is no evidence that a Russian-assisted missile has entered service.
